shape.means: square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure
soft, generous corners; friendly and calm
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth

label.means: plain words with a thick coloured underline that runs into a leader
a luggage tag tied to the part with a curved string
a saturated pill with a pointer line and a dot on the part (the classic)

bubble.means: an inked, cut-cornered bubble with a sharp wedge tail
a sticky note taped up, tilted, with a folded corner
a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs

panel.means: no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule
a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)
a solid colour block with a hard offset shadow

icon.means: an open ring with a gap and a bead, icon inside
the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
the icon knocked out of a coloured disc (the classic)

mark.means: a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)
a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark

texture.means: a dot screen fading out of one corner
diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.means: things slide in from the side they relate to
things fade up gently, labels wipe like type being set
things drop in and land, panels settle

camera.means: the camera pushes into the part that matters (guidance for the storyboard)
cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
